- **Open-item #1 (default on/off/WoT): CLOSED** — there is no framework default. WoT-gating is demoted from "future refinement / v1-requirement" to *just one policy value*. "Explicit-only" (the second opinion's preference) is another value, not a privileged posture.
- **Moment 1 vs moment 2 unchanged:** one resolver, one cache, two entry points. The policy gates *only* the content-renderer entry point. Explicit search/paste is never policy-gated — it's a distinct user action carrying nip05's existing trust model. [...] - **Moment 1 vs moment 2 unchanged:** one resolver, one cache, two entry points. The policy gates *only* the content-renderer entry point. Explicit search/paste is never policy-gated — it's a distinct user action carrying nip05's existing trust model. [...] 4. Moment-1 (AdUrlResolver impl for NmpApp, policy-gated, open_ad_collection) + Moment-2 (AdCandidate arm dispatch, never gated, parallel search) behind a nip-ad feature. 7 unit tests. doctrine_lint_smoke green. [...] - nmp-native-runtime (new nip-ad feature): Send NmpReadHost handle = ONE canonical ReadHost impl, NmpApp delegates (lets an off-thread resolve open a collection). Moment-1 AdUrlResolver impl gated by app-injected AdResolutionPolicy (default NeverAutoResolve). Moment-2 AdCandidate arm dispatches the same resolver, never gated; parallel search already fires. set_ad_resolution_policy composition seam. nip-ad enabled in nmp-app-gallery.
- All shells render AdCandidateUrl as plain-link baseline: SwiftUI (canon+iOS copies), Compose (canon+Android copies), desktop+TUI (built clean), web. jsrepo bundles regen'd.
